projectDescription: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that wraps the U.S. Department of Education's College Scorecard API, enabling AI assistants and agents to search schools, compare institutions, and explore programs using natural language.
keyFeatures: MCP-native server exposing College Scorecard data to AI assistants and agents
search_schools tool for full-text and filtered school searches
get_school tool for retrieving detailed data on a single institution
compare_schools tool for side-by-side institutional comparisons
find_programs tool for discovering programs by field of study or CIP code
Server-side API key management — no credentials exposed to clients
Public HTTPS MCP endpoint ready for immediate integration
Backed by the U.S. Department of Education's official College Scorecard dataset
publicApiSurface: POST /mcp — MCP protocol endpoint (tool calls, tool listing)
tool: search_schools(query, filters) — search institutions by name, location, or attributes
tool: get_school(id) — retrieve full scorecard data for a single school
tool: compare_schools(ids[]) — compare two or more institutions side-by-side
tool: find_programs(cip_code?, keyword?, school_id?) — discover academic programs and fields of study
